main_text.head: In Dispositiones Oratorias

head.i: Viri, dum viveret, Celeberrimi in omni Eruditione,
Sui quondam Præceptoris ad ultimam Memoriam suspiciendi.

main_text.p: Heb.11.4Post Mortem quoque spirat Abel; mirabile dictu! Exanimis loquitur: Sic Sacra Scripta docent. Hæc Fidei Vox est, sunt hæc quoque Sanguinis ora; Dum Caro fit Pulvis, non cineratur Amor. Sic etiam Hipstedii vivit post Funera Virtus, Cujus inexhausti Pectus Amoris erat. Sic tacet & loquitur, sic spirat mortuus Idem; Crede mihi, Eventum Ligna Futura dabunt.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page (large name "JOHANNIS STEPHANI" and text lines in the centre and lower right) is not transcribed. The lower-right block of faint text beneath "DISPO-" is show-through and was left out, except for the hyphenated word "DISPO-", which is printed at the line end. Marginal reference "Heb.11.4" stands beside the first verse line. Lines of the lower block of verse-like text are too faint to read reliably.
